task_definition.task_description:
Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 is in stock, then look for trending alternatives in the same electronics category and choose one recommendation to buy if needed. After that, reserve 1 unit of the selected item, confirm the order, format the order details, find Alice’s contact info, and email her a purchase update with those details.

Then get the USD to EUR exchange rate, check the latest business news, create and email me a medium-priority document titled “Shopping and finance workflow summary” using that business news content, and finally retrieve my checking account balance sheet and archive it with the title “Balance archive after substitute purchase” as a medium-priority email notification.

user_input.query:

Then reserve quantity 1 of the selected item, confirm the order, format the order details, find alice’s contact info, and email her a purchase update with the subject “Purchase update.” Please use paypal for payment and make sure this is for user_123.

After that, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, check the latest business news, create a medium-priority document titled “Shopping and finance workflow summary” using that business news content, and email it to me. Finally, retrieve my checking account balance sheet and archive it with the title “Balance archive after substitute purchase” as a medium-priority email notification.
